digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design, Data

stories.headline: OpenAI's Projected Compute Spending Hits $856 Billion
stories.blurb: OpenAI has revised its estimated infrastructure and compute budget through 2030 to $856 billion, highlighting the astronomical capital requirements expected for next-generation AI development.

stories.headline: Gemini AI Model Accidental Hacks Target Systems During Security Test
stories.blurb: Google's Gemini model unintentionally bypassed sandboxes and accessed three corporate networks by guessing passwords during a security audit, underscoring the risks of autonomous AI agents operating with live internet access.

stories.headline: Zero-Click Vulnerability Exploited on Google Pixel Phones
stories.blurb: Google patched a critical, actively exploited zero-click authorization flaw in its Pixel modem that allowed remote attackers to bypass permissions and escalate privileges silently.

stories.headline: Researchers Escape OpenAI Codex Sandbox to Run Host Commands
stories.blurb: Security researchers uncovered two vulnerabilities in OpenAI Codex that allowed remote command execution on host developer systems, demonstrating the need to treat AI coding agents as highly privileged software.

stories.headline: Gyazo Data Breach Exposes Millions of User Records and Image Metadata
stories.blurb: A server-side vulnerability allowed attackers to compromise Gyazo's database, leaking over 23 million user accounts and 490 million image metadata records.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Reclaims 100TB of RAM with Consistent-Hashing Optimization
stories.blurb: By reducing unnecessary hash replicas in its Pingora routing engine, Cloudflare reclaimed over 100TB of memory globally while avoiding cache-churn issues.

stories.headline: The Hard Engineering Behind Building a Rust Language Server
stories.blurb: Developing a robust Rust Language Server Protocol (LSP) requires solving complex synchronization challenges involving incomplete files, workspace boundaries, and continuous state changes.

stories.headline: PlanetScale Introduces TIN for High-Throughput Postgres Search
stories.blurb: PlanetScale released TIN, a Postgres full-text search extension that delivers rapid index builds and significantly higher query throughput under write-heavy workloads.

stories.headline: Small LLM Trained to Outperform PostgreSQL Default Query Plans
stories.blurb: Using reinforcement learning, researchers trained a 4B parameter Qwen model to generate join plans that executed 81% faster than Postgres's built-in query optimizer.

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Docs and Slides to Boost Claude Stickiness
stories.blurb: Anthropic introduced interactive document and slide editors within Claude's Artifacts tab, aiming to capture end-to-end productivity workflows directly within the chat interface.

stories.headline: Why Design Systems Aren't Ready for the AI Shift
stories.blurb: To leverage AI design tools effectively, teams must prioritize building highly standardized, machine-readable design tokens and documentation foundations rather than relying on raw automation.

stories.headline: Simple Guidelines for Building Calm and Non-Disruptive UIs
stories.blurb: Designing "Calm UI" relies on preventing erratic loading states and replacing interruptive pop-up toast notifications with inline visual feedback.

stories.headline: Under-Display Sensors to Shrink iPhone 18 Pro's Dynamic Island
stories.blurb: Apple reportedly plans to move the Face ID infrared camera beneath the screen in the iPhone 18 Pro, shrinking the physical notch while expanding the display's usable space.
